rules.title: How to play
rules.flow.title: Basic flow
rules.flow.body: Each player gets 17 cards, with 3 bottom cards. After bidding, the landlord takes the bottom cards and leads. After two consecutive passes, the last player to play leads again.
rules.sequences.title: Sequences
rules.sequences.body: Straights need at least 5 cards, consecutive pairs at least 3 pairs, and airplanes at least 2 triples. Twos and Jokers cannot be part of a sequence.
rules.attachments.title: Attachments
rules.attachments.body: Supports triples with one or a pair, airplanes with singles or pairs, and four-of-a-kind with two singles or two pairs. Airplane wings cannot reuse the body.
rules.comparison.title: Beating a play
rules.comparison.body: Normal plays must match type and length with a higher main rank. Bombs beat normal plays; the Joker rocket is highest.
rules.multiplier.title: Multipliers
rules.multiplier.body: Robbing, bombs, rockets, springs, and anti-springs double the multiplier. A landlord wins or loses two base shares.
rules.privacy.title: Privacy and fairness
rules.privacy.body: Computer players use only their own cards, public card counts, and public play history. They never read your hidden hand.
